title: Is it possible to alternate Top down phases and Sidescroll phases ?

posts.author: Aemil
posts.body: And how to do it, I always found tutorials explaining how to do complete sidescrollers but none about mixing gamplays (if it is possible) and I would like to have some clues about how to do it, thanks in advance

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
There's no such thing in RPG Maker as "top down" or "sidescroll". (the default graphics
are
top down, but it's not some kind of mode in the game)
So, since you'd have to add such things yourself, of course you could choose to move between them.
The obvious difference would be artistic, so you'd have different tilesets portraying things from a side view, which...you just transfer between maps or change the tileset.
And then you'd need to change what the controls do. There are already plugins to help you do that, and you should be able to toggle anything they change. The tutorials you've looked up probably already gave you examples of plugins for this.

posts.body:
